main_text.p: the envy whereof notwithstanding your own doctors and masters, you see, help us to bear off, and teach us how to decline; I now come to the examination of the particular points by you propounded. It should indeed be your part by right to be the assailant, who first did make the challenge: and I, who sustain the person of the defendant, might here well stay, accepting only your challenge, and expecting your encounter. Yet do not I mean at this time to answer your bill of challenge, as bills are usually answered in the chancery, with saving all advantages to the defendant: I am content in this also to abridge myself of the liberty which I might lawfully take, and make a further demonstration of my forwardness in undertaking the maintenance of so good a cause, by giving the first onset myself.
